title: Design
body: The app is great, but it has one flow, in the habits you should mark it as done just once in a day, now you can press plus forever in each habit. And it shouldn’t be like this.

author: Tamarytr

title: Truly amazing
body:
It’s incredible how easy habitica made it for me to change my life for the better. Really couldn’t recommend it more. 

Other than the app being great - it’s FREE so what do you have to lose? + there are so many incredible people on the app that are always happy to help with any questions, whether regarding habitica or real life issues!
author: Shalev Cohen

title: Itamar
body: I love the game, but the new update caused my app to change language to Hebrew, which makes the tasks, habits and all sort of other stuff invisible. I don't mind using the app in English, but there is no way I know of to change language in the app. Can you please fix it?🙏🏼
